title: Anthropic expands its Cognizant partnership to put Claude inside industry platforms
friendlyTitle: Cognizant will add Claude to more business systems
summary: Anthropic and Cognizant are expanding their partnership to embed Claude in Cognizant’s industry platforms and enterprise delivery work. Anthropic says more than 30,000 Cognizant associates have been trained on Claude as the consultancy becomes a Global Premier Partner.
friendlySummary: Anthropic and Cognizant are working together more closely. Cognizant plans to put Claude into tools used by its business customers.
whyItMatters: Enterprise AI adoption is moving from standalone chat tools into the software and processes used by specific industries. Buyers should ask how models are governed, measured and handed off to people inside each workflow, not only which model is included.
friendlyWhyItMatters: More workers may meet AI inside the software they already use. Companies should check how the AI is controlled and how its results are reviewed.
